== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Twin Star]] Sect is an organization founded by [[Eithan]], who identifies as a founding member and personal acolyte to the [[Sage of Twin Stars]]. While some believe it is an ancient institution, it was actually established as a way for people to find security and community during times of chaos. The sect is inclusive, accepting members regardless of their specific [[Path]], and offers training from highly skilled instructors. Its name is derived from the [[Path of Twin Stars]], which relates to having two cores. The sect's presence is marked by various two-colored star banners and robes in shades such as pale blue, burnt orange, red, navy, and scarlet. Its headquarters are located in [[Serpent's Grave]], featuring facilities like training halls carved from dragon bones and an aura chamber. The organization has grown significantly, with its symbols appearing throughout [[Sacred Valley]] and its influence extending over territories like the [[Wei clan]]'s. Members are overseen by leaders such as [[Kelsa]], who acts with the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Sage]], and they are protected by entities known as the Twin Guardians. Despite its growth and role in providing protection, some observers have expressed concerns, even labeling the group a cult due to its associations.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Twin Star]] Sect is identifiable by their two-colored star banners that surround the city and their light blue robes accented with orange and red highlights. Members of this sect are practitioners of either dream or light [[Paths]]. During a significant conflict, combat takes place within the sect's own compound. Ultimately, [[Lindon]] relocates the entire organization.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Identified by their split star symbol and two-colored star banners, the [[Twin Star]] Sect has maintained a working relationship with the [[Hall]]. Despite these ties, certain individuals have accused the sect of being a [[Dreadgod cult]]. As their flags fly over [[Sacred Valley]], members of the sect have been known to spread legends regarding [[Jai Chen]]. Ultimately, the group gathered in the name of [[Lindon]] because people sought to borrow the protection offered by the [[Void Sage]].}}
